theorems.name: Submission.br_top_dim_lattice_approximation
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → X.mass < ∞ → X.boundary.mass < ∞ → ∃ (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (β : ℕ → LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1) → ℤ) (Pk : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1)), (∀ k, 0 < ρ k) ∧ (∀ k, IsLatticeChain (ρ k) (fun F => (β k F : ℝ)) (Pk k)) ∧ WeaklyConvergesOn Pk X ∧ (⨆ k, (Pk k).boundary.mass) < ∞
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
